data.reasoning: The package is a standard -bin AUR package with pinned checksums from official upstream releases and standard post-install messaging. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an inconclusive verdict solely because it encountered an HTTP 400 API error when attempting to audit checksum.sh. The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and correctly determined it was a safe, standard maintainer utility, resulting in a safe overall verdict.
coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to review checksum.sh due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), leaving a coverage gap that forced an inconclusive result.
learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful fallbacks for transient LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) on individual files so that a single file failure does not unnecessarily poison the entire package verdict as inconclusive.
